summary: Niki BioSolutions, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting it regained compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price rule. On March 5, 2026, Nasdaq notified the company of a deficiency because its common stock closed below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days, granting a 180-day compliance period until September 1, 2026. On August 4, 2026, after the stock closed at or above $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days (July 21 – August 3, 2026), Nasdaq confirmed compliance and closed the matter. This routine compliance update is not a special situation; watch for any future delisting risk if the price falls again.
